facts.text: The hotel is on Avenue Louise in Brussels.
facts.excerpt: Nestled in the most exclusive district on the most prestigious venue Avenue Louise, the Wiltcher's invites you to feel the heartbeat of the city.

facts.text: The hotel's address is 71 Avenue Louise.
facts.excerpt: 71, Avenue Louise / Louizalaan 71

facts.text: The hotel carries the Steigenberger Icon designation, which only selected Steigenberger hotels may use.
facts.excerpt: Only the most legendary Steigenberger hotels are permitted to call themselves “Steigenberger Icons”.

facts.text: The hotel marks its 110th anniversary.
facts.excerpt: THE WILTCHER'S 110TH ANNIVERSARY

facts.text: The hotel's library is popular with locals as well as hotel guests.
facts.excerpt: The library is equally popular among locals and hotel guests of the Steigenberger Icon Wiltcher's.

facts.text: Loui Cocktail Bar & Restaurant serves regional and international cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Loui Cocktail Bar & Restaurant with regional and international cuisine

facts.text: Loui Bar & Restaurant is award-winning.
facts.excerpt: Unique dishes and culinary delights await you at any time of the day at the award-winning Loui Bar & Restaurant.

facts.text: The hotel has a swimming pool.
facts.excerpt: Swimming pool

facts.text: The hotel has a spa and wellness centre.
facts.excerpt: Escape the stressful daily routine and relax in our SPA and wellness centre.

facts.text: The fitness gym has modern cardio equipment.
facts.excerpt: fitness gym (complementary) with modern cardio equipment

facts.text: The hotel has a terrace.
facts.excerpt: refined bar, terrace, library, pool.

facts.text: Superior room bathrooms have both a bathtub and a shower.
facts.excerpt: The comfortable bathrooms are equipped with a bathtub, shower, hairdryer and a vanity mirror.

facts.text: Deluxe rooms are furnished with fine wood furniture and have a Nespresso coffee machine.
facts.excerpt: furnished with fine wood furniture, you can also expect a Nespresso coffee machine

facts.text: Duplex suites have separate living and sleeping areas over two floors, with entrances on both floors.
facts.excerpt: we recommend a duplex suite with separate living and sleeping areas over two floors with entrances on two floors.

facts.text: The Royal Suite has a living room with an open fireplace.
facts.excerpt: an office with a large desk and a living room with an open fireplace

facts.text: The Royal Suite bathroom has a whirlpool and a steam shower.
facts.excerpt: The bathroom trumps with whirlpool and steam shower.

facts.text: Junior Suites have a separate living area for working.
facts.excerpt: In our generously designed Junior Suites, a separate living area for working awaits you

facts.text: The hotel offers 24-hour room service.
facts.excerpt: 24h room service

facts.text: The nearest parking is a public car park, which charges a fee.
facts.excerpt: Public car park (fee required).

facts.text: Pets are allowed on request, for a fee.
facts.excerpt: Pets are allowed on request (fee required).

facts.text: The hotel is non-smoking.
facts.excerpt: Non smoking hotel

facts.text: The hotel has conference rooms.
facts.excerpt: Are you looking for a conference room in Brussels? Let our conference rooms convice you.

facts.text: Children up to six stay free in their parents' room when using existing beds.
facts.excerpt: Children up to 06 years stay free in parents room when using existing bed(s) in room.

facts.text: Breakfast is served in the café.
facts.excerpt: generous breakfast in the café

facts.text: The hotel describes five-star superior service as its mantra.
facts.excerpt: The passion and uncompromising five-star superior services are the Wiltcher’s mantra.
